about_the_game:
QR Code Generator Plus - Extended Edition

An upgrade to the standard QR Code Generator that unlocks professional tools for creating unique QR codes. Keep all the basic features while gaining powerful new branding and design capabilities.

What's New in Plus Version:
✔ Advanced color and background customization
✔ 4 exclusive design styles
✔ Logo integration feature
✔ Additional export formats (SVG, EPS, JPG, PDF)
✔ Transparency settings

All standard version benefits:
✓ Works offline
✓ Fast generation and copying
✓ Simple intuitive interface

QR Code Generator Plus - everything you love about the regular generator, plus premium branding features.
